404 Not Found when retrieving a nonexistent response

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let response_id = r#"resp-nonexistent"#;
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.retrieve_response(response_id).await;
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
